sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Bookings"."customer_id" AS e, "Customers"."good_or_bad_customer" AS g, AVG((CAST(("Bookings"."amount_of_discount" - "Bookings"."amount_of_refund") AS REAL) / "Bookings"."amount_of_refund")) AS m1 FROM "Bookings" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Bookings"."customer_id"  GROUP BY "Bookings"."customer_id", "Customers"."good_or_bad_customer"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"), "s5" AS (SELECT AVG("s4"."m2") AS v FROM "s4"), "s6" AS (SELECT "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, ("s4"."m2" - "s5"."v") AS m3 FROM "s4" JOIN "s5" ON "s5"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s4"."m2" > "s5"."v") SELECT AVG("s6"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s6"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s6"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s6"
